info.title: Car Rental Management System API
info.description:
Comprehensive REST API documentation for the Car Rental Management System.

### Authentication
Endpoints requiring authorization are protected with JWT Bearer authentication.
1. Call `/api/auth/login` to obtain an access token.
2. Click the **Authorize** button at the top right.
3. Paste your token (with or without 'Bearer ') and click **Authorize**.
